tags: A real bottle on a black stage
A wear clock for the notes
features: One real bottle photograph with ink-in-water drifting over the stage
A wear clock: slide through eleven hours on skin and watch which notes lead
Three sizes, a working bag and a checkout that gives real fill and delivery dates
A 2 ml sample and delivery threshold handled in the bag
name: Marée
short: A real bottle on a black stage, ink in the water, and a clock for the notes.
long: One photograph of the bottle on dark stone, with ink drifting slowly through the water around it. The notes are five short lines on a wear clock: slide through eleven hours on skin and the ones you would smell light up. Then straight to three sizes and a bag that knows when the bottle is filled and when it reaches you.
proves: Luxury that sells, without a single gold gradient.
story: A fragrance house that refuses the category's default gold. Built to show that a luxury site can be calm, photographic and still get the bottle into the bag in two taps.
